definitions.gloss: not meeting the standard; off-spec; irregular (produce)
definitions.explanation: Not meeting a set standard of size, shape or quality. It is used especially of fruit and vegetables that are too large, too small or oddly shaped to be sold through the usual channels, and of goods that fail an inspection.

definitions.gloss: out of the ordinary; extraordinary (of a person's ability or scale)
definitions.explanation: So far beyond the usual that ordinary measures do not apply, used admiringly of talent, strength or scale: {規格外|きかくがい}の{才能|さいのう} (an extraordinary talent).

examples.english: Badly shaped tomatoes count as off-spec.

notes:
⟦{規格|きかく}→規格：16939_kikaku⟧ (standard, specification) + 〜{外|がい} (outside of). It usually takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {規格外|きかくがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ / ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: irregular vegetables / off-spec goods
- {規格外|きかくがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: an extraordinary talent
- {規格外|きかくがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧: an unusually large size

SIMILAR WORDS:
